tray.title: AI variant generation
tray.label: AI Variants
tray.subtitle: Variants being generated in the background — click an entry for details.
tray.cancelConfirmation: Cancel this variant generation? The AI's work so far will be discarded and the provisioned exercise copy deleted.
tray.cancelFailed: The generation job could not be cancelled. It is still running.

wizard.title: Create a new variant with AI
wizard.backgroundHint: You can close this window — generation continues in the background and the result will be here when you come back.
wizard.startFailed: The generation job could not be started. Please try again.
wizard.failedGuidanceWithExercise: The exercise copy was already created before the failure. Open it in the editor to review what was applied and finish the remaining steps manually.
wizard.failedGuidanceNoExercise: No exercise was created. Review the step summary below to see why it failed, then start a new generation — adjusting your instructions often helps.
wizard.draftWithWarnings: The variant was kept as a flagged draft — review and repair it in the editor.
wizard.draftGuidance: Not every check passed, so the variant was kept as a draft. Open it in the editor, fix what the warnings point at, and publish it once it works.
wizard.aiDisclaimer: AI-generated content may contain errors. Review the variant carefully before publishing it.

select.intro: Select one or more aspects you'd like the AI to change.
select.difficultyHint: Change how hard the exercise is
select.domainHint: Move to a different real-world theme
select.narrativeHint: Choose the narrative style of the task

configure.customPlaceholder: e.g. Make the problem about sorting instead of searching. Keep the same point value.

narrative.TECHNICAL_DESCRIPTION: No story — a plain, concise focus on the technical concepts.
narrative.REALISTIC_DESCRIPTION: A short real-world scenario introduces the task — the rest stays technical.
narrative.CREATIVE_DESCRIPTION: A story carries the task — themed setting, named actors, story-driven examples.
narrative.IMAGINATIVE_DESCRIPTION: Fully creative storytelling — the entire exercise is told inside a rich narrative world.

placement.question: Where should this variant be placed?
placement.newGroupHint: Groups the source exercise and this variant together
placement.standaloneHint: No group — exercise appears on its own in the list
